lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَتَلَّهُۥ is in the derivative form: تَلَّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ت/ل/ل   t–l–l hill, heap, mound, elevation, to mount, to heap up; to knock down, to lay down, to be tough, to be stocky, to agitate. Of this root, تَلَّ talla occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَلَّ talla i [v. trans.] to throw or lay someone face down, with his mouth or forehead touching the ground, or on his side with the side of his forehead touching the ground

(37:103) فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِين when they had both submitted [to God], and he had laid him down on his forehead.
